Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK FOR 15 NOS. OF ELECTRICAL MANPOWER: 1. List of required Manpower on outsourcing basis: Sl.no. Description Quantity i. High skilled substation operator 1 no. ii. Skilled Substation Operators 7 nos. iii. Technician(Electrical) (Skilled 4 nos. iv. Wireman 2 nos. v. Skilled Telephone Operator 1 no. Total 15 nos. 2. Contractor will be responsible for supply of manpower and its operation & Maintenance. Contactor is respo nsible for properly maintaining the system as well as to do regular maintenance and fault rectification. 3. Annual contract for Electrical Routine operation and maintenance of substation, maintenance of overhead/ underground line, operation and maintenance of pump-sets, maintenance of residential and non- residential buildings etc. 4. Details of area to be maintained are as below: i. 33/11/0.415 KV substation · 5 MVA indoor type transformer and allied HT/LT switchgears 2 No’s · DG set 625 KVA 1 No.and 55KVA 1No. · 1600 KVA indoor type transformer and allied HT/LT switchgears 4 No’s · 630 KVA indoor type transformer and allied HT/LT switchgears. 2 No’s ii. Non Residential area as follows: · Kakatiya Guest House · Baghmati Guest House · Parks · CISF Barrack · CISF canteen · CISF parade Ground etc. iii. Residential area as follows:- · Mint House · Quarters- I, II, III · CGM Mint House etc iv. Overhead/Underground lines, street lights at factory/colony area · Underground lines · Overhead lines · Feeder pillars

· Junctions boxes · Street light etc. v. Pump House:- · Pump set centrifugal pump- 60 HP (02 No.) and 45HP 02 No · Ground water reservoir pumping station vi. Firm shall repair and replace electrical items in residential and non-residential buildings. vii. Substation, Transformer & DG Set Maintenance : · Daily: Monitoring of temperatures, oil levels, silica gel, explosion vent, voltage, and load r eadings, etc. · Monthly: IR measurements, physical inspections, cleaning, alarm testing. etc. · Quarterly: BDV testing of transformer oils, tightening of connections, etc. · DG operations: Fuel refills, oil check, fault rectification, switchovers, and start-stop cycles, all etc. viii. Overhead Line, underground line & Streetlight Maintenance: · Maintenance of ~200 streetlights(Approx.) · Maintenance of underground lines approx. 07 km. · Visual inspections, cable jointing, replacement of lights, tightening, terminating, and re-joi ning cables. · Details of Spare required for Centrifugal pumps and underground cable. 5. Duties and Responsibilities of Skilled Substation Operators (7 No.) a. Operation and Monitoring of 33/11KV MSDS, 11KV/440V three Substations of IGMH 24*7 b asis round the shifts. b. Basic up-keeping/cleaning of respective 68 Feeders of all Substations. c. Switching ON and OFF of HT and LT Breakers:- During the faults, Substation Breakers are t o be switched ON & OFF to feed the supply to concerned departments/ Sections. d. Checking the healthiness of incoming cables measuring the IR values of the incoming cabl es and outgoing circuits. e. Checking the Tripping units: Condition of the tripping units are to be checked once in ever y shift for effective operation of tripping relays and S/S relays. f. Checking the tightness of wires, cleaning of circuit breakers body and bushings every mon th. g. Tightening of nuts and bolts of all feeders of all Substations Monthly basis. h. Checking Oil & Winding temperatures on hourly basis against rated values and recording them in relevant log book. i. Observation of oil levels in main conservator tank OLTC conservator and examining for oil leaks from the transformer, if any and report the same to In charge Electrical maintenance department. j. Monitoring temperatures of all feeders. k. Monitoring of Relay Control Panels. l. Attending the faults and restoration of the power supply without delay. m. Opening and inspection of MDB/DB, checking and inspection of cable connection. n. Operation of panels, switchgears, transformers, battery etc. as per the approved procedur e. o. Change-over of 8 No’s of transformers. p. Checking the colour of silica gel in the breather and also oil level of the oil seal. If silica gel colour changes from blue to pink then same should be informed to In-charge Electrical Mai ntenance department. q. Lubricating/greasing all moving parts of OLTC mechanism. r. Operation and Monitoring of FCBC DC Panel of MSDS. s. Operation and maintenance of All Boundary Wall Lights and shop floor lighting. t. Cleaning and Housekeeping of MSDS and Substations. u. Basic day to day Maintenance and watering of earth pits connected to All Substation. v. Operation of switch yards; maintaining hourly reading records pertaining to PF, KWH Read

ings, MD. w. Switching ON/OFF of light fixtures, pumps, fans and other equipment’s as per IGMH Requir ement. x. Ensuring the closing of all the panel doors etc. y. Checking of CT, PT and Relays connections for tightness. Tightening of all earthing connec tions of all Panels. z. Measurement of insulation resistance value of circuit breaker. aa. Checking and sealing of cable entry holes and Panel openings as per directions of In charg e Electrical Maintenance. bb. Trouble shooting and repair of lighting and power circuits, including changing of light fittin gs etc. cc. In case of failure of TSSPDCL Power, Generator sets have to be Operated/restored and distr ibute the power to all important loads in the IGMH as directed by supervisor and In charge of Electrical Maintenance department. dd. Educational Qualification and experience of Substation Operators [Skilled]: · ITI in Electrician Trade with NCVT Apprentice with 3 year experience. · ii. Experience should be in the Operation and Maintenance of not less than 11KV Subst ations for substation operators. 6. Duties and Responsibilities of High skilled substation operator: (1 No) a. Supervision of all 11KV and 33KV basic substation maintenance works in accordance with SOP and Safety protocols. b. Operation and Monitoring of the Basic General Substation maintenance works of 33/1 1KV MSDS, 11KV/440V 3 No’s Substations of IGMH. c. Operation of 33kV Circuit Breakers, Isolator, LT Panels consisting of ACBs, etc. accordi ng to load requirements and instructions from Electrical Maintenance department. d. Maintaining the Power Factor close to unity through Automatic Power Factor Control P anels. Monitoring, Operation and Switching of APFC and AHF panel if in case any PF de viation. e. Monitoring temperatures of all feeders and maintaining records. f. Maintaining records of all the operations and records of loads such as voltage, current , power factor, frequency, connected load, energy consumption etc. g. Monitoring of Relay Control Panels and Maintaining records for the same. h. Checking of Panel heaters & rectification if required. Report any abnormality. i. Maintaining records of Power failures with reasons. j. Recording all tripping of breakers and other events that occur in the order of sequenc e with the time of occurrence and recording them in Log Book. k. Change-over of 8 No’s of transformers and Measurement of Oil BDV periodically and maintaining records. Maintaining records for Winding and Oil Temperatures and Silica Gel Breather. l. General Monthly cleaning of transformer, Inspection for any cracks or chippings of th e bushing and checking of tightness of connections. m. Measurement of IR values of transformer and recording of the values specifying the te mperature at which measurements are taken. n. Testing of transformer oil of main tank & OLTC oil for BDV and moisture content at lea st per every two months and submission of reports to the in charge, Electrical mainten ance. o. Checking of all connections on the transformer for tightness such as bushings, tank earth connection. p. Checking of D.C. supply. Operation and Monitoring of FCBC Panel of MSDS. Measurem ent of Battery Voltages and Current. Keeping the records for the same. q. Checking whether indication lamps, selector switch, ammeter, voltmeters, energy me ters etc., are working. Reporting if in case any abnormality. r. Checking of termination of incoming and outgoing cables. Routing of cables for new lo ads if required as directed by I/C Electrical Maintenance department. s. Measurement of Earth pit resistance of earth pits connected to All Substation and kee ping the records for the same. t. High skilled Substation Operator shall carry out routine Surveillance to observe any p redictable fault in electrical system such as Lighting Arrestors, CTs, PTs, Isolator, Circui

t Breakers, Control Panels, Transformers, OLTC Panels, LT Distribution System, Lightin g fixtures etc. and report the same to In charge, Electrical maintenance department. u. Educational Qualification and experience Substation Operator [High Skilled]: · BE/B. Tech in Electrical Engineering/ Electrical and Electronics Engineering with minim um 2 years’ experience {or} Diploma in Electrical Engineering/ Electrical and Electroni cs Engineering with minimum 5 years’ experience. Experience should be in satisfactory operation and maintenance of 11kV or high capacity Substation. · The Substation Operator high skilled so appointed shall be the person holding a valid Electrical Supervisor’s Certificate of Competency or 11KV License issued by competent electrical authority of state or central Government. 7. Duties and Responsibilities of Technician (Electrical) (Skilled): 4 No. a. Operation and Basic General Maintenance of 11KV/440V Substation. b. Electrical maintenance works of All Residential quarters ( Type:1, Type-2,Type-3, Type-4 an d Type-5) c. Electrical maintenance works of Mint House, 18 No’s Hostel/Baghmati Guest House; Kakatiy a VIP Guest House; CISF Barrack and Pump house; d. Maintenance of Overhead lines. e. Maintaining Complaint registers and Monthly meter reading registers. f. Opening, inspecting, cleaning of JB’s /switch boxes, checking the tightness of connections i n the internal wiring circuits for all buildings of Township. g. Trouble shooting and repair of lighting and power circuits, including changing of light fitting s etc. h. Checking of earth continuity and cable connection in the lamp holders, ceiling rose (if any), socket outlets, fan regulator connection etc. i. Operation and Maintenance of All township Street lights. j. Maintenance of Main Distribution Boards, PDB’s k. Maintenance of checklist pertaining to earth pits of Township. l. Switching ON/OFF of light fixtures, pumps, fans and other equipment as per IGMH Require ment m. Educational Qualification and experience for Technician(Electrical) [Skilled] · ITI in Electrician Trade with NCVT Apprentice with 3 year experience. · Experience should be in the Operation and Maintenance of not less than 440V Substat ion and having adequate knowledge in repairs, Installation and fixing of various electric al fittings, fixtures and knowledge of domestic wiring. 8. Duties and Responsibilities of Telephone Operator: 01 No. a. Responsible for the daily operation, monitoring, b. Software updation/modifications of feeds/management and Regular testing of the EPABX sy stem. c. Repairs/ rectification/ upkeep of telephone lines, Krones and Telephone Junction Boxes. d. He would also be responsible for maintaining telephone Bill records and log books. e. Educational Qualification and experience for Telephone Operator [Skilled]: · ITI in Electrician/Electronic Mechanic/ Instrumentation Trade with NCVT Apprentice wit h 3 year experience. · Experience should be in the Operation and Maintenance of Software updation/modific ations of feeds/management, and Regular testing of the EPABX system. 9. Duties and Responsibilities of Wireman: 02 Nos.

a. The Electrical Wireman shall be responsible for installation, operation, inspection, testi ng, preventive and breakdown maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of electrical wi ring, cables, overhead lines, lighting systems, distribution boards, and other electrical i nstallations. He shall ensure proper earthing, electrical safety, use of PPE, compliance with approved work procedures, maintenance of records, and timely reporting of defec ts and unsafe conditions to the competent authority. b. Educational Qualification and experience for Wireman [Skilled]: · Wireman Certificate with 05 year experience. · Experience should be in the installation, operation, inspection, testing, preventive and breakdown maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of electrical wiring, cables, lightin g systems, distribution boards, motors, control panels and other electrical installations. 10. The bidder should submit the acceptance of Scope of Work (SoW) & Buyer Added Servic e Level Agreement (SLA). XII. Non- Blacklisting Certificate. . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) i. Mentioned 15 numbers Manpower is Indicative only. However as per the future needs and requ irements of Electrical Maintenance department, on the sole discretion of the Chief General Man ager IG Mint Hyderabad, Number of Contract manpower may decrease during at any time of c ontract period as per the actual needs of IGM Hyderabad. Bidder should be in a position to dec rease manpower accordingly; In such case no penalty will be imposed over man-days deviatio n. ii. Month wise shift duty charts will be prepared and issued by the Supervisor, Electrical maintena

nce department-IGMH; same should be followed by the manpower deputed without fail. iii. One Day in a Week as decided by In charge Electrical maintenance department will be weekly off for deputed Manpower. iv. Contractor should ensure mandatory availability of Manpower in the shifts as per the rosters as decided by the Electrical maintenance Department of IGMH. The contractor shall ensure to pro vide an alternate qualified manpower or replace with a standby in case any of the staff deploy ed is absent. v. In case of weekly rest, public holiday, absenteeism: alternative arrangement i.e. Reliever who i s equally qualified & experienced should be made by the Contractor. vi. All the activities and shift operations will be supervised and coordinated by IGMH Electrical Mai ntenance department. vii. The deputed Manpower is required to be present in their respective shift till the next shift oper ator reports for duty. viii. The contractor shall have his own PF code no. with the RPFC as required under Employee PF & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 and extend benefits of Employees Provident Fund 1952, Em ployee Deposit Linked Insurance 1976 and Employee Pension Scheme 1995 to contract worker s deployed. ix. The contractor shall have his own ESI code No. allotted by Employee State Insurance Corporati on (ESIC) as required under Employee State Insurance Act 1948. The contractors shall submit t he Separate e-Challans / ECR along with bank receipts/bank statement on monthly basis as a p art of compliance and proof of depositing of ESI contribution with ESI Authorities. The contract or should arrange Smart Cards (i.e. ESI Identity Card) /e-Pehchan Card to contract labors enga ged by him from the Corporation. x. Wages paid by the Contractor to the persons employed shall not be less than the minimum wa ges prescribed uder the minimum wages act fixed by the State Government or the Central Gov ernment from time to time, whichever is higher along with other statutory dues such as EPF, E SI, and Bonus etc. xi. Updated/ Revised Wages shall only be paid to employees strictly as per timely guidelines of Min imum Rates of wages as notified by Central Government or State Government, whichever is hi gher. xii. The contractor shall pay all the statutory payments on or before 7th day of every successive m onth through NEFT/RTGS & provide proof thereof also must submit the certified authenticated proof of depositing PF, ESIC in the name of all employees engaged by him. xiii. The payment to the Contractor shall be made on monthly basis on satisfactory completion of s ervice on presentation of the bill certified by the Electrical Maintenance department of IGMH. N o advance payment will be made. xiv. In case of any labour disputes for non-payment of minimum wages to the workers or any other disputes, the payment due to the contractor can be withheld till settlement of the disputes by the IGMH or on the orders of the Court of law. xv. The necessary statutory deduction as applicable shall be deducted from the amount payable to the Contractor and it is mandatory on the part of Contractor to provide PAN number, Service ta x registration number etc. whenever asked for. xvi. The Contractor shall employ only adult trained, efficient and responsible staff with good health and sound mind for operation and maintenance of electrical installation work. The Contractor s hall ensure that the persons are punctual and disciplined and remain vigilant in performance of their duty. Persons so engaged by the Contractor shall be from amongst properly trained elect rician of high integrity and good conduct. In no circumstances, persons below 18 years of age s hould be employed. xvii. Contractor should ask the persons depute under his contract to maintain individual diaries and

Daily log book of operations/works performed by staff deputed. xviii. The contractor shall follow the provisions of the Electricity Act 2003 and the Regulations framed there under. xix. The personnel so selected should be instructed to maintain decorum of good behaviours at all times. xx. In no case, the contractor or his/her employees shall claim job / employment with IGMH. xxi. Contractor will be responsible for any act of sabotage, misdeed, indiscipline, and negligence on the part of contractor or his employees. Penalty or legal action, as decided by CGM, IGMH shall be imposed on the contractor. xxii. Measures like smoking, drinking, abusing during the working hours is strictly prohibited and if fo und that the personnel engaged in such act shall be immediately replace with suitable alternat ive. xxiii. Any damage or injury to the person so deployed by the contractor or by other persons and any damage to the property within the IGMH due to negligence of contractor or his representative shall be sole responsibility of the contractor. xxiv. In case of any accident during the operation / maintenance of equipment, leading to injuries / d amages to human bodies / equipment, or loss of life, the contractor shall be fully responsible f or settling all claims arising out of such accidents and indemnify the department from such clai ms. xxv. The IGMH does not bind itself to buy or produce any or all services/goods from the Contractor n ecessarily. xxvi. The contractor should get the character checked of the entire workforce deployed by them at t he work premises, before engaging & deploying them in IGMH premises. The contractor needs to provide to IGMH a declaration to the effect that there is no case with the Police/Court/Regula tory authorities against their employee. Latest and valid Police Verification Certificate (PVC) to be submitted to IGMH for issuing gate passes. xxvii. Any lapse on the part of the tenderer/agency in the discharge of their duties which may result i n monetary loss or loss of reputation to IGMH will result in imposition of penalties at the discre tion of the Chief General Manager, IGMH. xxviii. In the event of any loss caused to the India Government Mint on account of contractor’s men, t he contractor shall make good the loss either by proper replacement or on payment of adjusta ble compensation. xxix. Contractor must ensure 26*15= 390 Man-day’s fulfilment during every month of contract. Allot ment of suitable replacement will be the responsibility of the contractor. Failing which differen ce of Man-days will be deducted from the SD of the Contractor at the end of contract and also c onsidering the losses incurred to IGMH due to non-deputation of manpower, The contractor sh all be liable to be fined as deemed fit on every single occasion on the sole discretion of the Chi ef General Manager, IGMH. xxx. The MSDS shall never be left unattended at any time; substation operator must be available at MSDS Round the clock as per the roster as decided by the Sr. Supervisor, IGMH. In case of brea ch of this, the contractor shall be liable to be Blacklisted and fined as deemed fit on the sole di scretion of the Chief General Manager, IGMH. xxxi. Contractor must ensure execution of all works as entrusted in the scope of work on time and sh ould maintain MSDS and Substation as per Indian Electrical Standards. In the event of unsatisf actory service or any failure at any time on the part of Contractor to comply with the terms an d provisions of this contract to the satisfaction of Mint, the Chief General Manager shall be the sole judge and whose decision shall be final and binding. The contractor shall be liable to be fi ned as deemed fit on every single occasion on the sole discretion of the Chief General Manage r, IGMH. xxxii. Contractor will be responsible for any act of sabotage, misdeed, indiscipline, and negligence on

the part of contractor or his employees. Penalty or legal action, as decided by CGM, IGMH shall be imposed on the contractor. xxxiii. The Contractor shall be fully responsible for payment of not less than revised and updated mini mum Rates of wages as notified by Central Government or State Government, whichever is hig her. The Contractor shall be fully responsible for payment of PF contributions, ESI or any other benefits under various Labour Laws/Acts applicable to him and or the personnel employed by h im. If contractor found not following the mentioned payment structure his/her firm will be blac klisted for not less than 2 years and respective contract’s SD will be forfeited and fined as dee med fit on the sole discretion of the Chief General Manager, IGMH. xxxiv.
